intended_object: Its docstring calls it an auxiliary definition for `equivMonComonCounitIsoApp`. It is the identity isomorphism on the underlying object of M, used to build the counit of the equivalence between bimonoids and monoids in comonoids.
explanation: This definition is just `Iso.refl _` between two objects that are definitionally equal: the underlying object of `M` after the round trip Mon(Comon C) → Bimon C → Mon(Comon C), and the underlying object of `M` itself. It is an intermediate step that helps build the counit isomorphism of an equivalence of categories. It has no mathematical meaning of its own.
